carousels.topic: Weekly Market Rebound and Liquidity Check
carousels.caption: Wall Street mounted a sharp holiday comeback, but major resistance levels and contracting liquidity remain unresolved. Key levels across equities, gold, and digital assets define the trend ahead. Follow for tomorrow's update.

slides.title: S&P 500 Hits 7,297: Real Rebound?
slides.body: Here is what the weekly moves in stocks, gold, and Bitcoin mean for the trend ahead.

slides.title: Wall Street Relief Rally
slides.body: The S&P 500 gained 1.7% to 7,297, facing resistance at 7,350. A decisive move above 7,300 is needed to establish a bottom.

slides.title: Nvidia Swings Thirty Percent
slides.body: Nvidia rebounded 30% from its trough after a 48% drop. Year-end portfolio rebalancing keeps semiconductor valuations vulnerable to fresh downside tests.

slides.title: Gold Under Paper Pressure
slides.body: Gold sits near $3,640 after forced liquidations. Paper derivative volume exceeds physical trade by 165 times, while central banks bought 321 tonnes.

slides.title: Bitcoin Defends Structural Support
slides.body: Bitcoin trades near $59,673, testing support at $58,000. Reclaiming $67,000 is required to confirm a reversal, with stablecoin supply down $20 billion.

slides.title: Key Macro Week Ahead
slides.body: Upcoming jobs data will determine if equities can clear structural resistance. Follow for tomorrow's update.
